description: A summer camps does science experiments in two pre filled beakers, beaker 1 and beaker 2. Beaker 1 uses 4 units of flour and 6 units of special liquid to make 5 units of slime. Beaker 2 uses 6 units of flour and 3 units of special liquid to make 3 units of slime.  However, beaker 1 creates 4 units of waste while beaker 2 creates 2 units of waste. The summer camp has available 150 units of flour and 100 units of special liquid. If at most 30 units of waste can be produced, how many of each beaker should be used to maximize the amount of slime produced?

FlourUsagePerBeaker.definition: Amount of flour used by each beaker

SpecialLiquidUsagePerBeaker.definition: Amount of special liquid used by each beaker

SlimeProducedPerBeaker.definition: Amount of slime produced by each beaker

WasteProducedPerBeaker.definition: Amount of waste produced by each beaker

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total amount of slime produced from the two beakers"

constraints.description: Total flour used by all beakers should not exceed 150 units
Total special liquid used by all beakers should not exceed 100 units
Total waste produced by all beakers should not exceed 30 units
The number of times each beaker is used should be non-negative

UseBeakers.definition: Number of times each beaker is used
